findings.explanation: This clause obligates you to perform any additions or alterations requested by the client without any change-order mechanism or additional compensation, exposing you to unpaid extra work.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request modifications to the deliverables, provided that any material additions or changes in scope shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order detailing the additional fees.

findings.explanation: Revisions are tied to the client's sole discretion with no specified limit on rounds, meaning you could be required to revise your work indefinitely.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall be entitled to up to two rounds of revisions on deliverables, after which any further revisions requested by the Client shall be subject to additional fees at the Contractor's standard rates.

findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation via work-for-hire and present assignment language, before you are guaranteed payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client, and the Contractor hereby assigns such rights conditioned upon receiving full payment.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on work product completeness, this obligates me to perform any additions or alterations requested without a change-order mechanism or additional compensation, exposing me to unpaid extra work. I propose modifying this so that the Client may request modifications to the deliverables, provided that any material additions or changes in scope shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order detailing the additional fees. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership of the work product transfers immediately upon creation via work-for-hire language, before I am guaranteed payment. I propose modifying this so that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client, and the Contractor hereby assigns such rights conditioned upon receiving full payment. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
